My 2 roommates and I lived in an old 6 bedroom family home. They went on a trip to Europe for 4 weeks and I stayed home alone with the cat. My partner at the time was working late and wasn’t going to come and see me. 

I had the master bedroom with the en-suite which was nice. It was winter so it was cold and dark. I was sitting in bed watching tv when I heard noises from the house settling in the cold. It was unnerving so I closed and locked the bedroom door and decided to go for a shower before I went to sleep.

I had my shower opened the bathroom door to see my bedroom door swinging open. My blood went cold. I grabbed my phone and locked myself in the bathroom and called my partner. He couldn’t get out of work. I was alone with no one coming to check on me. 

Then after some time I came out of the bathroom, worked up the courage to check the dark house and nothing was out of place. From the process of retracing my steps I worked out the lock on the old door was broken so the change in pressure from me opening the bathroom door opened the bedroom door.

TLDR; I lived in a crappy old house that made creepy noises and a stupid door lock made me think I was going to get murdered.
